channel.title: Netlify incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Netlify's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Increased Latency in IAD Region on Global Network [resolved]
Elevated HTTP 500 errors serving sites and the Netlify UI [resolved]
item.description: On August 18 between 20:02 and 20:08 UTC, some visitors to Netlify-hosted sites and people using the Netlify dashboard received error pages instead of the content they requested. Normal service was restored at 20:08 UTC. We apologize for the disruption

item.title: Errors Uploading Attachments to Agent Runners [resolved]
Elevated error rates for a subset of sites using Edge Functions [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved. Between approximately 17:00 and 20:30 UTC, a subset of sites using Edge Functions experienced elevated 504 error rates. We applied a mitigation and error rates have remained at normal levels since. We apologize for the impact to your sites and visitors.

item.title: Blobs issues in Sydney region [resolved]
item.description: Between May 29th at 15:30 UTC till June 2 6:08 UTC, we experienced sporadic issues with Blobs in our Sydney region, affecting any Function using Blobs, including the ones that are generated by the framework runtimes. Our team has deployed a fix and the errors have subsided.

item.title: Failed & delayed builds due to Github incident [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved, and builds have returned to functioning normally.

item.title: Elevated response times affecting origin services [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved. The issue that was causing elevated errors, increased latency, and intermittent site availability across Netlify services has been mitigated. All services, including site delivery and the build pipeline, are now operating normally. We monitored system stability following recovery and are no longer observing elevated error rates or degraded performance

item.title: Elevated Build and Functions Deployment Errors [resolved]
item.description: Between 17:38 and 17:57 UTC, we experienced elevated error rates affecting the Build Pipeline. Some customers may have encountered failed deploys or HTTP 500/503 errors during deployment processing. The systems are recovering and we're continuing to investigate the root cause

item.title: Degraded performance with Create API [resolved]
item.description: The incident with performance degradation for create.netlify.com has be resolved.

item.title: Purges are Delayed on Primary Load Balancer [resolved]
Build Issues due to Github Outage [resolved]
Degraded Service in IAD Region [resolved]
item.description: Our network experienced degraded service in the IAD region between 12:53 UTC and 13:53 UTC. This issue is now resolved.

item.title: Issues Processing Account Changes [resolved]
item.description: We experienced issues processing account changes between 19:09 and 19:33 UTC. Users may have encountered issues when attempting to use Agent Runners, purchase credits, view credit usage, or complete account transactions. This issue is now resolved.

item.title: Agent Runner failures on new projects [resolved]
Delayed Credit Usage Updates [resolved]
item.description: Some customers may have seen delayed credit usage updates and related notifications between 00:14–01:37 UTC on May 3. The issue has been resolved, and usage information is now up to date.
